summary: Find/replace on text or a file  -  regex or literal  -  with an expected-count guard; preview by default, writes only with write:true (or apply:true).

pattern.description: regex pattern, or exact string when literal:true (required)

path.description: file to edit (used if 'text' absent); confined to the roots

literal.description: match an exact string, not a regex

expected_replacements.description: refuse unless exactly this many matches are found (the safety belt)

expected_source_sha256.description: the reviewed-source witness: sha256 of the file bytes a preview reported. Refuse if the file has changed since. Omit to apply unwitnessed

write.description: write back to path (else preview only)

source_sha256.description: sha256 of the source bytes this call read (path source only)

apply_with.description: send back unmodified to apply exactly what was previewed; carries the source witness
